purpose: Next placement iteration after fixed18_L800 failed its quadrant rule (5 of 8). Test whether a weaker heartland prior fixes the regional split of town counts, with the strength chosen on one Earth pool and judged on the other.
known_before_declaration: Quadrant results of production and fixed18_L800 (output/settlement_release2_20261113/results.json): the finalist loses Han south-west, Han south-east and Rome north-east. Centre counts per quadrant against observed cells: Han finalist 97/1012/24/106, production 160/377/394/308, observed 217/841/87/119.

Whole-pool scores of the 224 earlier draws. Among them, fixed spacing was only run with L 800 km or no prior on older inputs; intermediate strengths at fixed 18 km spacing have not been scored on the current inputs.
All pools are exposed. The family below was chosen after seeing where L800 fails, so this is development with a cross-pool check, not blind validation.

family.allocator: Unchanged fixed-count greedy allocator: natural production count, legacy site score, no two centres within 18 km, weight multiplied by exp(-D/L) with D the supported core travel distance.
family.control: L 800 must reproduce the committed fixed18_L800 positions exactly.

metric: Same quadrant definition and Q as the release-2 confirmation test. For each variant, pool and quadrant: Q of the variant and Q of production.
cross_pool_selection: For each pool, choose the L with the highest mean of the four quadrant Qs on the OTHER pool (ties to the larger L, i.e. weaker prior). Judge this pool's four quadrants and whole-pool Q with that L.
pass_rule: The cross-selected variants beat production in at least 6 of the 8 pool-quadrants AND in both whole pools.
if_pass: Adopt for the fantasy map the single L with the highest mean of all eight quadrant Qs; rebuild positions, tracks, hinterlands, sizes, collection catchments and ledgers, publish as the Settlements default and say plainly that the test is cross-pool development, not blind.
if_fail: Positions stay as they are. Report every variant and the count split by quadrant. The next step is then a regional count model, not another prior strength.
reported_regardless: All 7 variants x 2 pools x 4 quadrants, centre counts against observed cells per quadrant, whole-pool Q, and what an in-pool (non-crossed) selection would have chosen.
review: Independent recomputation of placements and scores; byte replay.
